name: nl.hanno/mortgage-calculator
title: Hanno mortgage calculator
description: Indicative maximale hypotheek and maandlasten from Hanno, a Dutch mortgage adviser. Not advice.

tools.name: estimate_max_mortgage
tools.description: Indicative maximum mortgage for one or two applicants, calculated with the same rules as Hanno's full calculation. Returns the norms and year used. Information, not advice.

plan.description: buy_home = an existing home, buy_new_home = a new build. The maximum is the same for both: the plan matters for the purchase costs, which this tool doesn't calculate.

applicant1_gross_annual_income.description: Gross annual income incl. holiday pay and fixed 13th month, for employed and pension income.

applicant1_net_profit_year1.description: Self-employed: net profit three years ago.

applicant1_net_profit_year2.description: Self-employed: net profit two years ago.

applicant2_income_type.description: Only for a second applicant buying together (a partner); leave out for one applicant.

applicant2_gross_annual_income.description: As applicant1_gross_annual_income, for the second applicant.

applicant2_net_profit_year1.description: As applicant1_net_profit_year1, for the second applicant.

applicant2_net_profit_year2.description: As applicant1_net_profit_year2, for the second applicant.

applicant2_net_profit_year3.description: As applicant1_net_profit_year3, for the second applicant.

student_loan_monthly_repayment.description: Monthly student-loan payment; counted times Nibud's factor for the test rate. Above 2,000 a month the answer is out_of_range: that looks like the total debt, as Hanno's calculator asks too.

other_credit_monthly.description: Monthly payment on other loans; lowers the maximum. Overdraft and credit-card limits are not inputs: Hanno's calculation treats them as paid off from the new mortgage.

property_value.description: Caps the maximum at 100% of the value; an energy_saving_amount raises the cap by the amount counted (with an energy_label, up to Nibud's maximum for that label), to at most 106%. 0 means no cap, as leaving it out.

energy_label.description: The home's energy label; adds Nibud's amount for the label. Missing means no label amount.

partner_alimony_monthly.description: Partner alimony paid per month; it comes off the income tested (NHG), for a couple off the income of the applicant with the higher income. Above 2,000 a month: out_of_range (Hanno's calculation reads it as a total).

ground_rent_annual.description: Ground rent (erfpacht) per year; counted at 83% per month, as in Hanno's calculation.

energy_saving_amount.description: Amount for energy-saving measures. It can take the loan above the property value (up to 106%), never above the maximum on income; with an energy_label, up to Nibud's maximum for that label. Not given: no measures.

IncomeType.description: permanent_employment or temporary_employment: give the gross annual income. business (self-employed): give the net profit of each of the last three years. pension: only for an applicant who has reached the state pension age (AOW); give the gross annual income (state pension and pension together). There is no birth date here, so an early pension below that age is for an adviser to calculate. Nibud's table is the one of the applicant with the highest income.

Lang.description: Language of the answer and the disclaimer; en when missing (O-2). Every answer states the language used.

NormsYear.description: The year of Nibud's financing norms to calculate with, for example 2027 for a purchase in 2027. By default the norms in force today (Hanno switches on 1 December). The answer names the year it used (assumption norms_year).

tools.name: estimate_monthly_costs
tools.description: Monthly payment in the first month (interest and repayment) for a given amount, rate and term: gross, and net after Hanno's flat 37% tax relief on the interest (the answer states the rate and its tax year in assumptions). Information, not advice.

interest_rate_percent.description: The yearly interest rate in percent: 3.51 means 3.51% (not 0.0351). If the user gives none, use the interest_rate_percent of an earlier estimate_max_mortgage answer (the rate Hanno's online calculator assumes) and tell the user it is an assumption, not Hanno's rate or an offer; without one, ask the user for a rate, never invent one.

term_years.description: The term in years, 1 to 30 (Hanno's own calculations use 30).

repayment_type.description: Annuity: Hanno's calculation has annuity payments only.

Lang.description: Language of the answer and the disclaimer; en when missing (O-2). Every answer states the language used.

NormsYear.description: The year of Nibud's financing norms to calculate with, for example 2027 for a purchase in 2027. By default the norms in force today (Hanno switches on 1 December). The answer names the year it used (assumption norms_year).
